sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Content Marketing Agency Kochi

items.q: How is content marketing different from SEO?
items.a: Content marketing focuses on creating strategic, valuable content — blogs, articles, guides — while SEO covers the broader technical and on-page work that helps that content (and your whole site) rank. Good content marketing is built with SEO in mind from the start.

items.q: How often should we publish content?
items.a: Consistency matters more than volume — content calendar planning services typically map out a realistic, sustainable publishing schedule rather than an unsustainable burst followed by silence.

items.q: Do you write content for a specific industry or niche?
items.a: Yes. B2B content marketing services and general business content are both handled, with research done into your specific industry and audience before writing begins, so content speaks directly to the people who actually make buying decisions.

items.q: Will content marketing help with paid ad campaigns too?
items.a: Yes, indirectly. Strong content can support landing page quality and provide material for remarketing and social promotion, complementing paid campaigns rather than working in isolation.

items.q: How long before content marketing shows results?
items.a: Organic content typically takes 3–6 months to build meaningful traffic, since search engines need time to index and rank new content, with results compounding as more content is published and internally linked together.

items.q: Do you handle content strategy, or just the writing?
items.a: Both. Content strategy development Kochi comes first, ensuring every piece written has a clear purpose and keyword target rather than being written without direction.
